name: Pine
description: Pine is a website template for small mountain guesthouses, with a hero that pairs the house photo with trail signposts showing walking times to nearby sights and a date and guests bar, room cards with prices per night, a trails section with a summer and winter switch, a hosts section with key facts, guest reviews and an availability form. Forest green, cream and the colours of mountain trail marks with Oswald headings give the website a calm, outdoor character. Replace the copy, prices, trails, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with trail signposts showing walking times and an arrival, departure and guests bar
Room cards with guests, size and price per night
Three room pages with amenities and a booking enquiry
Trails section with a summer and winter switch and route facts
Hosts section with key facts about the guesthouse
Guest reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Area page with summer trails, waterfalls and winter slopes nearby
Availability enquiry form with dates and room choice
